brief:
Israeli filmmaker Yuval Abraham said Palestinian journalists have documented the truth of the Gaza conflict from its first day, Middle East Eye reported. Abraham, identified as a NAZA director, made the statement in apparent recognition of the reporting work carried out by Palestinian media workers throughout the war.

The comment comes amid broader debates over conflict coverage and the role of Palestinian news organizations in shaping international understanding of events in Gaza.
dek: NAZA director: Palestinian journalists have documented Gaza truth from day one Israeli filmmaker Yuval Abraham has said that Palestinian journalists have been documenting truth from the first day of Gaza conflict.
title: Israeli filmmaker credits Palestinian journalists with documenting Gaza war from start
